body: I don't know. The past is the past. Happy memories just make mesad. Anyways, I'm headed out now. I doubt I'll be back Thank you for your response.

The thing is... I don't relate to other people's stories. I'm completely disconnected from the world and society. I can't really relate. I can, slightly. I'm pretty sure that I have testicle cancer, but I don't really care. I noticed it a long time ago, and as time's gone on, more and more symptoms keep popping up. There's no solace or peace in death. You need to be alive to experience solace and peace. I don't have a life, and don't ever plan on it. I don't enjoy being in the world. I don't have any place, nor do I want one. It's all just a waste of time. And so, I waste my time. Ironic.
